name: Windows Dialog Yes to All
visual_description: Retro Windows XP style alert popup showing 'Select option...' with a cursor clicking the 'Yes to All' button.
usage_context: Used to express eagerly or helplessly accepting all bad options, vices, or life problems simultaneously.

example.question: Do you want anxiety, insomnia, or caffeine addiction?

text_areas.description: Question or prompt offering multiple choices
